subject: SIG: access controls package and final evidence deliverables
thread_body:
--- Message 1 ---
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@acmecorp.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Jones <mike.jones@acmecorp.com>
Subject: SIG: follow-up on access controls (SSO/SCIM/RBAC/MFA)

Rachel — thanks for the quick SIG submission yesterday. A few follow-ups from our security team to close out the access controls section before we mark it complete:

- Can you confirm whether MFA is enforced for all interactive admin accounts (console + API key management)? We need the enforcement policy and a recent sample enforcement log.
- SCIM provisioning: please provide a CSV export of provisioning events for the last 30 days (created/updated/deprovisioned) and the attribute mapping you use (externalId -> employee_id).
- SAML: need IdP metadata and an anonymized sample SAML assertion showing NameID and role attributes.
- RBAC / least privilege: can you share the current role matrix for platform access and any planned changes to default role assignments for new accounts?

If possible, send the artifacts (SCIM CSV, IdP metadata, RBAC matrix) by EOD Tue, Mar 22 so our audit team can finish the SIG worksheet. Happy to take a short call Weds morning if that helps.

Lisa
ACME Security

--- Message 2 ---
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 10:05:12 -0700
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@acmecorp.com>, Mike Jones <mike.jones@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: SIG: follow-up on access controls (SSO/SCIM/RBAC/MFA)

Hi Lisa — thanks, we'll compile everything and deliver a single package. Quick plan:

- Jonas will export the SCIM provisioning audit (CSV) and include a short README on timestamp formats and externalId mapping.
- I'll attach the IdP metadata (and an anonymized SAML assertion sample) and include the MFA enforcement summary (policy excerpt + recent enforcement events).
- Marissa will share the RBAC matrix and a short plan to remove the default admin assignment for newly provisioned users.

Expect the bundle by Tue EOD (Mar 22). If ACME wants a 30-min walk-through, we can schedule Thu or Fri.

Thanks — Rachel
Rachel Kim
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference

--- Message 3 ---
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 14:10:07 -0700
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Subject: RBAC matrix and suggested least-privilege defaults

Attached: rbac-matrix-20270321.csv (role, scope, allowed_actions, notes)

Rachel — sending the RBAC export. Highlights: 
- Roles: super_admin, infra_admin, org_admin, billing_admin, support_agent, read_only.
- Current on-boarding flow assigns org_admin to the first user created in an account; new request: change default to support_agent and require an explicit promotion to org_admin.
- Proposed change will be a config flag we can flip per-customer in Dedicated/Private deployments; for hosted accounts we can enable the safer default immediately.

Open items for ACME to confirm: which roles should receive console access vs API-only keys (we've annotated the matrix). If ACME confirms, we can schedule the rollout and include a changelog entry for the SIG evidence pack.

-Marissa
Director, Customer Security Programs | Redwood Inference

--- Message 4 ---
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 15:45:55 -0700
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Subject: SCIM export and provisioning logs

Attached: redwood_scim-provisioning-log-20270321.csv
Also attached: saml-assertion-sample.txt, idp-metadata.xml

Notes:
- CSV columns: timestamp, event_type (create/update/delete), scim_user_id, externalId, username, email, source (IdP), actor_id.
- externalId maps to HR employee_id in most customers; for ACME we use externalId = acme_employee_number when provided.
- Typical provisioning delay: 3-8s for create/update; deprovision may take up to 2 minutes depending on exponential backoff to downstream services.
- Sample SCIM PATCH entry included (we sanitized email domains and replaced names with placeholders).

If you need logs in a specific format (JSONL) let me know and I can re-export.

-Jonas
Senior SRE, Platform Operations | Redwood Inference

--- Message 5 ---
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 14:30:00 -0700
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Subject: Final SIG access controls package — delivered

Lisa / Mike — delivering the requested artifacts for the SIG access controls section. Package attached and uploaded to the shared Drive link below.

Attachments included in this message: sig_access_controls_responses-v2.xlsx, redwood_scim-provisioning-log-20270321.csv, idp-metadata.xml, rbac-matrix-20270321.csv, saml-assertion-sample.txt

Summary of what we provided:
- MFA: enforcement is enabled for all console and privileged interactive accounts. Enforced via IdP policy; logs show enforcement events for 100% of recent admin sign-ins (see sheet MFA-enforcement in the XLSX).
- SCIM: full provisioning audit for the last 30 days with externalId mapping details and a short README. Jonas included a sample PATCH and timing notes.
- SAML: IdP metadata attached and an anonymized SAML assertion showing NameID and role attributes.
- RBAC: role matrix attached and a proposed change to default onboarding privileges (recommendation: set default to support_agent; escalate to org_admin via explicit promotion).
- Least privilege: we highlighted actions requiring admin scope and suggested reducing default privileges for service accounts where applicable.

Next steps / asks for ACME:
- Please confirm which roles should have console access vs API-only.
- Let us know if you want the provisioning logs in JSONL or additional filtering for specific teams.
- If ACME is happy with the package, we will mark the SIG access controls section as "complete" in the worksheet and share an updated SIG spreadsheet.

Drive (read-only): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1exampleSIG
HubSpot: 12345

If helpful, I'm available for a 30-minute walkthrough Thu Mar 24 (09:00-11:00 PT) to go through the artifacts and answer any questions.

Thanks — Rachel
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
